def brush_trajectory(path, practice=False, speed=.012, lead=True):
    p=sample_dense(path)

    w=2*p[:,2]*MM
    dep=np.interp(w,[0,.5,1.72,4.17,6.38,8.83,13.73,17.4,26],[.55,1,2,4,6,8,12,16,24])
